brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Tallyline, the invoicing and cash-flow forecasting product in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: calm and trustworthy, friendly to freelancers, not the generic fintech blue-and-green. Web app only.

claim.notes: Üç konsept de (horizon 5,2; cairn 4,8; post 4,4) iki turluk kör eleştiri kapısında kaldı, bu yüzden finalize, export, install-assets ve gallery çalıştırılmadı.

concepts.title: Cairn
readsAs: a zen stacked-stone cairn (spa, meditation, wellness)
at 16 px a three-bar hamburger-menu-like stack
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s5 a faceted jar or lantern with a band label - a stone with a painted blaze only once told; s6 a luggage/price tag with a punched hole (struck: the product's own object for invoicing, tag cliche); s7 Pac-Man or a bird head with an orange beak, and the inset wedge reads as a '<' back chevron (struck: game/UI icon readings; the designer's favourite does not survive a cold look). s5 survives as the weakest-acceptable pick, not a strong one. Risks: silhouette is a symmetric hexagonal vessel (jar, hourglass, lighthouse); the band separated by gaps flirts with the slice device. Fix: make the outline an irregular, clearly stone-like standing rock (lopsided, one flat face), and make the ochre band a true diagonal brush-blaze painted ON the stone, not a slab that cuts it into three; drop the gaps so it is a mark on a stone, not a sliced stack. If it still reads as a jar after that, stop the concept.

concepts.title: Runway
readsAs: a swoosh/curve dropping down and trailing off into an ellipsis (loading or 'to be continued')
a reclined L followed by two dots
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s6 a filled and an empty oval side by side - a radio button / toggle state, stock primitives (struck: UI icon); s7 a solid rounded square with a hollow one behind it - the copy/duplicate icon (struck: UI icon); s8 a plum bean nudging a tilted orange ring - a footprint at a stretch, more a bead pair. s8 is the only survivor and only just: solid-vs-hollow does carry booked-vs-expected, but it is still two generic primitives (blob + ring) and will score low on distinctiveness unless developed. Keep: the shared tilt and the touch, which make it one gesture rather than two objects; plum/terracotta. Fix: make the two parts one drawn outline (the hollow as a continuation of the solid's contour, not a separate ring); give the solid an asymmetric, hand-set edge so it is not an ellipse; avoid any reading as an 'o', a %, a toggle or a snowman; check it never reads as filled/empty UI state at 16 px.

concepts.title: Waypost
readsAs: a text-input cursor between two dashes (-|-)
a minus sign, an l and a dash - a ruler tick
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a UI slider thumb on a track, or a plus sign; s2 an upside-down T (the perpendicular symbol) trailing a dash-dot, a timeline 'today' marker; s3 a post rooted in a road that sweeps up to a ball, a lowercase L with a swoosh; s4 two bars on a baseline, i.e. bar chart / tally marks (banned); s5 a media scrubber or slider at the start of its track. Struck s1, s5 (UI slider), s4 (bars/tally). s2 survives but is a stock inverted-T plus the chart-forecast ellipsis. Pick s3: the only one that is one gesture with a silhouette of its own, and it survives 16 px. Risks to fix: (1) the upward curve reads as a hockey-stick growth chart; lower the lift so it is a gentle horizon easing up, not a ramp; (2) post + curve + dot can read as 'Li' or a golf swing; give the dot a clear relation (sit it on the line's end, or make it the only ochre element at the horizon) rather than floating; (3) the foot where post meets line is currently a blob; make the join a deliberate, crafted junction; (4) keep it from reading as a plain L or J.
